name: Cold Outreach APSOC Pipeline
description: Genera sequenza email a freddo con framework APSOC + critique loop

stages.name: Target Research & Brief
actions: Parse user input: target, service, main pain point, differentiator
Search memory for similar past campaigns
Research target industry (web search if needed)
Build: ideal customer profile, top 3 pain points, decision-maker persona
Identify best APSOC angles for this specific target

stages.name: Email Sequence Generation
actions: Load APSOC prompt template
Inject target_brief into all placeholders
Generate Email 1 (Day 0): Pain + Solution angle
Generate Email 2 (Day 3): Case study / social proof angle
Generate Email 3 (Day 7): Break-up angle
Write strategic notes

stages.name: Copy Quality Critique
actions: Score each email on 6 dimensions (see prompt criteria)
Verify APSOC compliance: every section present and distinct?
Check word counts: E1 ≤ 100, E2 ≤ 80, E3 ≤ 60
Check CTA: single, clear, zero friction?
Check mobile readability: short paragraphs, white space?
Simulate reader perspective: would THIS target person reply?

stages.name: Copy Refinement
actions: Apply specific critique feedback
Strengthen weakest APSOC sections
Tighten copy (cut words, sharpen sentences)
Preserve strong angles, fix weak ones

stages.name: Output + Memory Save
actions: Format final email sequence as clean markdown
Save to output/outreach-[target]-[date]/
Update memory/decisions with campaign metadata
Update memory/strategies: which APSOC angles worked for which targets
Present to user with strategic notes
memory_writes: memory/strategies/store.json → update APSOC strategy with target-specific results
